posts.author: Theponidraws
posts.body:
Hi! I'm working on a game with my friend, and we want to add a minigame to one of the scenes. The problem is, we don't know how to program it, and we haven't found any tutorials that explain how to do it. Our reference is the game “Dead Plate,” where the player is in a restaurant, and some customers arrive. The player guides them to a table and has to serve specific dishes that the customers order. Once the character finishes eating, they leave. It's essentially a restaurant game.
If anyone could give us advice on how to program this event or provide a tutorial, we'd really appreciate it!
The reference:
(min 5:45)

posts.author: JohnDoeGames
posts.body:
It's actually very much doable without the use of plugins. You can create a timer by adding 1 to a variable every 60 frames (1 second).
Now you can events that represent the costumers. Give them all multiple pages, starting with a blanco page. Give the blanco page a moveroute to go to the entrance of the restaurant. Make sure Through is checked ON.
On the second page, you give them an actual image, and in the conditions (top left corner) select the variable from the first step, and set the first one to 10. The one of the next character to 20, the next thirty. And so on, and so on.
This makes a costumer spawn every 10 seconds. Use other numbers of you like.
Event those characters to follow you to a table, once interacted with, and and then make them place an order.
In the kitchen you make an object for each item on the menu. When interacting with one of those objects, remove all the menu items from your inventory, and then add the dish you picked up. (This to prevent the player just grabbing all dishes at once)
Then, back at the character, on the third page (after the order is placed) put a conditional branch that checks if the ordered item is in your inventory. If so, you successfully delivered the order, otherwise you got to go back to the kitchen and grab the right item.
Do this for all the costumer characters.
And that is basically all you need to do. Sounds like an easy job, and it is, but it is still going to be a lot of work, since every costumer is different. They have not only a different appearance, but they also have different spawn times, different orders and different move routes. So simply making 1 character and then copy/pasting them won't work.
I hope this helps!
